name: Subgrid Mod 2 Algorithm
definition: An ablation of subgrid marching tetrahedra that limits output to at most one intersection per edge (like classic marching) while using exact input intersection locations to improve primal vertex position accuracy.
summary: The Subgrid Mod 2 Algorithm extracts isosurfaces with classic Marching Tetrahedra connectivity but improves vertex accuracy by averaging exact intersection locations along edges.
